observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS' visible, and a red 'REBEL T1i' badge on the front right.
Photo 1 shows the top of the camera with the lens attached. The lens barrel has 'Canon' and focal length markings (18, 24, 35, 55). The mode dial is visible with settings like 'P', 'Tv', 'Av', 'M'.

Photo 2 shows the back of the camera with the LCD screen off. The screen is dark and reflects light. The camera has a viewfinder, menu buttons, and control dials. The lens is attached and appears to be in good condition.
All photos show the camera held in a hand, with a plain background. No accessories (battery, charger, memory card) are visible.
The seller claims it is a 'USA Used Canon EOS Rebel T1i with 18 - 55MM Lens, working perfectly ok with no fault'.

claims.claim: USA Used Canon EOS Rebel T1i with 18 - 55MM Lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Canon' and 'EOS' on the body, and 'REBEL T1i' on the front. Photo 1 shows the lens with focal length markings including 18, 24, 35, 55.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No photo shows the camera powered on or in operation. The screen is off in photo 2. No proof of functionality is visible.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter, sensor, or LCD issues)
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powered on, screen lit, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, scratches, or internal damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens glass, especially at the front and rear, and a video showing the lens being touched or moved.

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo showing the battery and charger included, or a video of the camera powering on with battery and charger.

risks.risk: Camera may have hidden mechanical or electrical faults (e.g., mirror lock-up, shutter failure)
risks.proof: Video of the camera taking a photo and showing the shutter count or a test shot with a known exposure.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera powered on and taking a photo.
Close-up photos of the lens glass, especially at the front and rear.
Photo or video showing the battery and charger included.
Video of the camera taking a photo and showing the shutter count or a test shot.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
